{{Quote|There is such pain now. The Song of the Universe is disrupted. The warriors are angry, and we swarm.|A Joiner, sharing the pain of tortured Killiks|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Song of the Universe''' was a melody known to the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] race.

==Background==
Among many races throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], especially those of insectile origins or with hive minds, the Song of the Universe was the natural harmony that was created by all living beings. It was believed that each creature and race had a part to play within the Song of the Universe and that the more they concentrated, the easier it would be to hear the Song. However, only true insectoid races were able to hear the entire Song, though the reasons for this were unknown.

[[Joiner]]s were also able to hear the Song and translate it into their native language.

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] agent [[Vector Hyllus]] became a Joiner and professed to hear the Song of the Universe, calling it a "magnificent thing."

After the [[Qoribu Truce]], the [[The Colony|Killik Colony]] nests that were located on the border of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] were moved via starships belonging to the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. Before they left the system of [[Qoribu]], the Killiks began singing the Song of the Universe.

[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] promised the Killik hive [[Wuluw]] that her numerous deaths during the [[Swarm War]] would mean that she would have her name sung in the Song of the Universe.
